conventions: Every edit to packages/catalog-model/src is comment-only: add lines inside new or existing /** ... */ blocks; never change, move or delete a code line, an import, an existing comment line, or a release tag.
Never add a blank line outside a comment block (no blank line between interface members or class members), so every added line of the src diff is /**, a ' * ...' line, or ' */'.

TSDoc blocks are always multi-line: '/**' on its own line, one ' * ' prefix per line, ' */' on its own line, indented to the member they document (2 spaces inside an interface or class, 0 at top level).
Wrap comment prose at about 80 columns; prettier (singleQuote, trailingComma all, arrowParens avoid; config at packages/cli/config/prettier.json) does not rewrap comments.

Summaries are one or two short sentence-case sentences ending with a period, in present tense and active voice, describing what the code does, never what the name suggests (doc style guide at docs/contribute/doc-style-guide.md).

Tag order inside a block: summary, blank ' *' line, optional '@remarks' section (tag line, blank ' *' line, prose), blank ' *' line, '@param <name> - <Description>' lines, '@returns <description>', '@throws <description>' when it throws, then any existing release tag last.
Parameter lines use the package form '@param value - The value to check' (name, space, hyphen, space, capitalised description, no trailing period).

Wrap literal values, field paths and code fragments in backticks (for example `backstage.io/v1alpha1`, `metadata.namespace`, `true`); use {@link Symbol} only for symbols exported from the package entry point (src/index.ts), such as {@link ApiEntityV1alpha1} or {@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain}.
Do not name internal, non-exported helpers or private fields in a comment (for example the local require/optional functions in FieldFormatEntityPolicy, or private fields such as parentRef).
Do not touch copyright headers; new non-source files (the changeset) carry none.
report.api.md and report-alpha.api.md are never typed: the api-reports project check regenerates them after the last unit.

decisions.topic: How the API reports are regenerated
decisions.choice: The first project check runs `yarn build:api-reports packages/catalog-model`, which regenerates report.api.md and report-alpha.api.md for this package only; the second asserts no `(undocumented)` marker remains in report.api.md.
decisions.reason: The unscoped run may rewrite other packages' reports, which are off-limits; a docs run holds no tooling unit; Gate 0 allows the reports to change only through the tool.

decisions.topic: Release tag position in the type guard blocks
decisions.choice: New lines go between the existing '/**' line and the existing ' * @public' line, so @param and @returns come before @public and @public stays last and unchanged.
decisions.reason: FR-4 requires the existing @public tag to stay unchanged and last, and inserting after '/**' keeps the diff additions-only.

decisions.choice: Link to the V1alpha1 interface name ({@link ApiEntityV1alpha1}, {@link ComponentEntityV1alpha1}, and so on), never the ApiEntity-style alias.
decisions.reason: The report prints guard return types as the V1alpha1 interfaces, and those names are exported from both entry points.

decisions.topic: Required versus optional wording in spec comments
decisions.choice: Required/optional wording follows the TypeScript type (a field without ? is required, a field with ? is optional); where the kind JSON schema disagrees with the type (User `memberOf` is optional in the type but required by the schema) the comment names the field without calling it required or optional.
rejected: follow the type and ignore the schema
decisions.reason: FR-3 forbids contradicting the type, and NFR-3 forbids a statement the schema makes false.

decisions.topic: Shape of the enforce method comments
decisions.choice: Each enforce block has a summary, an optional @remarks section for detail, '@param entity - ...', '@returns ...', and '@throws ...' only when the method body or an operation it performs throws.
decisions.reason: FR-6 asks for policy-specific return and throw behaviour, which the inherited generic text in entity/policies/types.ts does not give.

units.behaviour: Adds TSDoc blocks to the apiVersion, kind and spec members of ApiEntityV1alpha1.
rules: 1. S1 block text: 'The API version of the entity, either `backstage.io/v1alpha1` or `backstage.io/v1beta1`.'
2. S2 block text: 'The kind of the entity, always `API`.'
3. S3 block: summary 'The specification of the API.', then a sentence stating that `type`, `lifecycle`, `owner` and `definition` are required and `system` is optional.

4. S3 continues: `type` is the type of the API definition, `lifecycle` its lifecycle state, `owner` an entity reference to the owner, `definition` the API definition in the format given by `type`, and `system` an entity reference to the system the API belongs to.
5. Indent each block two spaces, matching the member it precedes; add no blank lines.

units.behaviour: Adds a summary, @param entity and @returns to each of the 8 kind type guards, above their existing @public tag.
rules: 1. Each site inserts, right after the guard's existing '/**' line, these lines in order: ' * <summary>', ' *', ' * @param entity - The entity to check', ' * @returns <returns text>', ' *'; the existing ' * @public' line then follows unchanged and stays last.

2. Summary for guard X with kind literal K and interface I: 'Checks whether an entity is of the `K` kind, comparing `entity.kind` to `K` case-insensitively.' followed by 'Only `kind` is checked; `apiVersion` and `spec` are not validated.'
3. Returns text: '`true` if the entity kind matches, which narrows the type to {@link I}, otherwise `false`.'

4. Pairs (guard, K, I): isApiEntity, API, ApiEntityV1alpha1; isComponentEntity, Component, ComponentEntityV1alpha1; isDomainEntity, Domain, DomainEntityV1alpha1; isGroupEntity, Group, GroupEntityV1alpha1; isLocationEntity, Location, LocationEntityV1alpha1; isResourceEntity, Resource, ResourceEntityV1alpha1; isSystemEntity, System, SystemEntityV1alpha1; isUserEntity, User, UserEntityV1alpha1.
5. Blocks are at top level (no indentation before ' *').

units.behaviour: Adds a TSDoc block with summary, @param value and @returns to each of the 8 static validator methods.
rules: 1. Each block is indented two spaces and has: summary, ' *', ' * @param value - The value to check', ' * @returns <text>'; every @returns says the method returns `false` for any non-string value.

2. isValidApiVersion: the value is either `<version>` or `<group>/<version>`; `<group>` must pass {@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain} (at most 253 characters of dot-separated lowercase DNS labels); `<version>` is 1 to 63 ASCII letters or digits; a value with more than one `/` is invalid.
3. isValidKind: 1 to 63 characters, starting with an ASCII letter followed only by ASCII letters or digits (for example `Component`).
4. isValidObjectName: 1 to 63 characters of ASCII letters, digits, `-`, `_` and `.`, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
5. isValidNamespace: delegates to {@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsLabel}: 1 to 63 characters of lowercase letters and digits, where hyphens may appear only between them (not first or last).

6. isValidLabelKey and isValidAnnotationKey (same rule, separate blocks): the value is `<name>` or `<prefix>/<name>`; `<prefix>` must pass {@link CommonValidatorFunctions.isValidDnsSubdomain} and `<name>` must pass {@link KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName}; a value with more than one `/` is invalid.
7. isValidLabelValue: the empty string, or a value that passes {@link KubernetesValidatorFunctions.isValidObjectName}.
8. isValidAnnotationValue: any string, including the empty string; there is no length or character limit.

rules: 1. Summary: fills in `metadata.namespace` with the namespace given to the constructor (`default` unless another is passed) when the entity has none.
2. '@param entity - The entity to process'.

3. '@returns' text: the same entity object, unchanged, if `metadata.namespace` is set to a non-empty value; otherwise a new entity object, deep-merged from the input over the default namespace, so the input entity is not modified.
4. Do not claim an empty-string or `null` namespace is replaced (the merge keeps the entity's own value); do not add @throws (the method throws no error of its own).

rules: 1. Summary: checks the format of the entity envelope fields with the validators given to the constructor (by default those of {@link makeValidator}).

2. @remarks lists, in order: `apiVersion`, `kind` and `metadata.name` must be present; `metadata.namespace` is checked only when it is not `undefined`; every label key and value, annotation key and value, and tag is checked; each entry in `metadata.links` needs a valid `url`, and its `title` and `icon` must be non-empty strings when not `undefined`; `spec` is not checked.
3. '@param entity - The entity to check'.
4. '@returns' text: the same entity object, unchanged.

5. '@throws' text: an `Error` naming the field when a required field is `undefined` or `null`, when a validator throws, or when a value fails its validator; for a known validator the message describes the expected format and links to the catalog file format documentation.

rules: 1. Summary: sets `spec.parent` of a `Group` entity that has none to the parent group reference given to the constructor, stored in lowercase `group:<namespace>/<name>` form.

2. @remarks: only entities whose `kind` is exactly `Group` (case-sensitive) are affected; a group that already has a `spec.parent` is left as is; the configured parent group itself is never given itself as parent; the entity is modified in place.
3. '@param entity - The entity to process'.
4. '@returns' text: the same entity object that was passed in, with `spec.parent` set where rule 1 applies.
5. '@throws' text: a `TypeError` if a `Group` entity has no `spec` object; the method throws no error of its own.

rules: 1. Summary: validates the entity against the entity envelope JSON schema, which requires `apiVersion`, `kind` and `metadata`, allows only the top-level fields `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata`, `spec`, `relations` and `status`, and checks `metadata` against the shared metadata schema.
2. @remarks: `spec` is only required to be an object when present; kind-specific spec fields are not validated here. The schema is compiled on the first call and reused afterwards.
3. '@param entity - The entity to validate'.
4. '@returns' text: the same entity object, unchanged, when it is valid.
5. '@throws' text: an `Error` whose message starts with `Malformed envelope,` and describes the first schema violation and its path (`<root>` for the top level).

units.behaviour: New patch changeset for @backstage/catalog-model announcing the added API documentation.
rules: 1. Front matter is exactly three lines: '---', "'@backstage/catalog-model': patch", '---'; then one blank line and one message paragraph.
2. Message: 'Added API documentation for the fields of the built-in entity kind types, the entity kind type guards, the Kubernetes-style validation functions, and the built-in entity policies.'
3. Name no other package and no code symbol (no function, class, method or variable names); no copyright header.
